text:
Alex: quick check-in: who here has committed YAML with a tab and lived to tell the tale? :raising_hand:
Priya: guilty. it was midnight and VSCode lied to me. :sweat_smile:
Lin: called it 'creative indentation' in the commit message once. regret follows. :face_with_head_bandage:
Alex: sample evidence (do not open if you're fragile):
```yaml
service:
	name: fast-infer
  replicas: 2
version: "1..0"
```
Priya: omg, two crimes: mixed indent + dotted semver. the compiler is taking notes. :memo:
Build-Bot: build #1702 failed: yaml - indentation error at line 2; semver validation error at `version`
Lin: we should add a precommit hook that replaces tabs with 2 spaces and bans `..` in versions. :thumbsup:
Alex: or a gentle Slack bot that replies with a compiler meme: "Compiler: I had a nightmare where everyone used tabs." :laughing:
Priya: vote: immediate fix (:one:) or rename main to `main-sad-legacy` and call it retro (:two:)?
Lin: :one: but retro branch for memes is ok.
Alex: also whoever introduced the `1..0` has to buy team donuts. rules of the internet. :doughnut:
Build-Bot: lint rerun triggered for branch fix/yaml-tabs; pipeline #1703 queued
Priya: small victory when the linter passes. applause and maybe a cake next all-hands. :tada:
Lin: lesson: YAML forgives, but semver remembers. :sparkles:
